description: Overlay for Webgrip's own packages: patch, digest and pin updates of anything Webgrip publishes (Harbor's webgrip project, ghcr.io/webgrip, @webgrip npm packages, webgrip repositories as actions or git tags) share one branch of their own that opens without a tick, skips the release-age soak and merges itself on green. Webgrip's release pipeline is the gate for these, so a soak only delays them, and a separate branch keeps a red third-party update from holding them back. Minors and majors keep the policy of the profile. The renovate-config preset bump keeps its own branch. Extend after the profile or the non-major overlay.

packageRules.description: Harbor's webgrip project holds only Webgrip's images; its proxy projects (dockerhub, ghcr, quay) are third-party and stay out.
